title: Smart Data Models - Weather base schema
description: Common definitions of weather data models

WeatherAlertCategories.description: Property. Weather categories. Enum:' avalanches,coastalEvent, coldWave, flood, fog, forestFire, heatWave, highTemperature, hurricane, ice, lowTemperature, rainfall, rain_flood, snow, snow_ice, thunderstorms, tornado, tropicalCyclone, tsunami, wind'

temperature.description: Property. Temperature of the item. Units:'degrees Celsius' (UN/CEFACT CEL)

feelLikesTemperature.description: Property. Temperature appreciation of the item. Units:'degrees Celsius' (UN/CEFACT CEL)

relativeHumidity.description: Property. Humidity in the Air. Observed instantaneous relative humidity (water vapour in air), as a fraction between 0 and 1

weatherType.description: Property. Text description of the weather. Model:'http://schema.org/Text'

windDirection.description: Property. Model:'http://schema.org/Number'. Direction of the wind, in decimal degrees clockwise from true north

windSpeed.description: Property. Model:'http//schema.org/Number'. Intensity of the wind. Units:'metres per second' (UN/CEFACT MTS)

gustSpeed.description: Property. A sudden burst of high-speed wind over the observed average wind speed lasting only for a few seconds. Units:'metres per second' (UN/CEFACT MTS)

refPointOfInterest.description: Relationship. Model:'http://schema.org/URL'. Point of interest related to the item

atmosphericPressure.description: Property. Model:'https://schema.org/Number'. The atmospheric pressure observed. Units:'pascals' (UN/CEFACT PAL)

illuminance.description: Property. Model:'https://schema.org/Number'. (https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/Illuminance) observed measured in lux. Units:'candela' (UN/CEFACT CDL)

temperature.description: Property. Temperature of the item. Units:'degrees Celsius' (UN/CEFACT CEL)

feelsLikeTemperature.description: Property. Temperature appreciation of the item. Units:'degrees Celsius' (UN/CEFACT CEL)

relativeHumidity.description: Property. Humidity in the Air. Observed instantaneous relative humidity (water vapour in air), as a fraction between 0 and 1

dateIssued.description: Property. Model:'https://schema.org/DateTime'. The date and time the item was issued in ISO8601 UTC format

validFrom.description: Property. Model:'https://schema.org/DateTime'. The start of the validity period for this forecast as a ISO8601 format

validTo.description: Property. Model:'https://schema.org/DateTime'. The end of the validity period for this forecast as a ISO8601 format

category.description: Property. Category of the Alert. Enum:'traffic, naturalDisaster, weather, environment, health, security, agriculture'

anyOf.description: Identifier format of any NGSI entity
Identifier format of any NGSI entity

alertSource.description: Relationship. Source of the alert. Model:'http://schema.org/URL'

data.description: Property. Payload containing the data retrieved
